subject: Reworking Saturday activity after priorities change
text: Hi there, sorry for the hurried email. I know we are classmates, but because you are the project manager, can we reshape Saturday's group activity after the priorities shifted? I started making a signup sheet, but now feedback forms matter first, so maybe split it into a quick walkthrough and a smaller working session. I can grab markers and set up tables, yet I might not know who should lead the second half. Please tell me whether to cancel the extra supplies or keep them on hold. Also, if the start time moves to four, I can bring the folder but not the heavy projector box. I hope this still works, and I will check the room again if needed.
